  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(*) as txn_count, 
  SUM(t.amount_usd) as total_usd, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failed_txn_count, 
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as failure_rate

  transactions t

  users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id

  login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id

  UPPER(u.account_status) = 'ACTIVE'

  AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-45 days') 
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument 
HAVING 
  failure_rate > 12 
  AND total_usd > 100000

SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT le.device_fingerprint) AS device_count, COUNT(DISTINCT le.user_agent) AS agent_count, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.instrument) AS instrument_count, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_events le2 WHERE le2.device_fingerprint = le.device_fingerprint AND le2.user_agent = le.user_agent AND le2.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')) AS total_agent_count, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_events le2 WHERE le2.device_fingerprint = le.device_fingerprint AND le2.user_agent = le.user_agent AND le2.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_events le2 WHERE le2.device_fingerprint = le.device_fingerprint AND le2.user_agent = le.user_agent AND le2.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')) AS agent_rate, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_events le2 WHERE le2.device_fingerprint = le.device_fingerprint AND le2.user_agent = le.user_agent AND le2.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_events le2 WHERE le2.device_fingerprint = le.device_fingerprint AND le2.user_agent = le.user_agent AND le2.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')) * 100 AS agent_rate_percent
FROM login_events le
JOIN users u ON le.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE UPPER(le.device_type) != UPPER(le.device_type) AND UPPER(le.user_agent) != UPPER(le.user_agent) AND 
      le.created_at >= date('now', '-1 hour') AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') AND 
      t.instrument IN ('CRYPTO', 'FOREX') AND le.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY u.full_name, le.device_fingerprint, le.user_agent
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT le.device_fingerprint) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT le.user_agent) >= 5
